title: Kathy Lambert/Quotes
summary:
"I've seen people wear these lately. I so don't get them."
- Kathy Lambert to Lok Lambert, about his Amulet, (Home Turf)

"What's going on?"
- Kathy Lambert, as she sees the Huntik team using their powers, (Back Home)

"She's never gonna get anywhere with Dante."
- Kathy Lambert to Sophie Casterwill, about Scarlet Byrne, (Back Home)
